verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.pt: Ordena aos filhos de Israel que te tragam, para o candeeiro, azeite de oliveira, puro, batido, a fim de manter uma lâmpada acesa continuamente.
verses.en_web: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.en_bbe: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clean olive oil for the light, so that a light may be burning at all times,

verses.en: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.pt: Arão a conservará em ordem perante o Senhor, continuamente, desde a tarde até a manhã, fora do véu do testemunho, na tenda da revelação; será estatuto perpétuo pelas vossas gerações.
verses.en_web: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
verses.en_bbe: Outside the veil of the ark in the Tent of meeting; let Aaron see that it is burning from evening till morning at all times before the Lord: it is a rule for ever through all your generations.

verses.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
verses.pt: Sobre o candelabro de ouro puro conservará em ordem as lâmpadas perante o Senhor continuamente.
verses.en_web: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.
verses.en_bbe: Let Aaron put the lights in order on the support before the Lord at all times.

verses.en: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.pt: Também tomarás flor de farinha, e dela cozerás doze pães; cada pão será de dois décimos de efa.
verses.en_web: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
verses.en_bbe: And take the best meal and make twelve cakes of it, a fifth part of an ephah in every cake.

verses.en: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
verses.pt: E pô-los-ás perante o Senhor, em duas fileiras, seis em cada fileira, sobre a mesa de ouro puro.
verses.en_web: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And put them in two lines, six in a line, on the holy table before the Lord.

verses.en: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.pt: Sobre cada fileira porás incenso puro, para que seja sobre os pães como memorial, isto é, como oferta queimada ao Senhor;
verses.en_web: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And on the lines of cakes put clean sweet-smelling spices, for a sign on the bread, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.pt: em cada dia de sábado, isso se porá em ordem perante o Senhor continuamente; e, a favor dos filhos de Israel, um pacto perpétuo.
verses.en_web: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Every Sabbath day regularly, the priest is to put it in order before the Lord: it is offered for the children of Israel, an agreement made for ever.

verses.en: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.pt: Pertencerão os pães a Arão e a seus filhos, que os comerão em lugar santo, por serem coisa santíssima para eles, das ofertas queimadas ao Senhor por estatuto perpétuo.
verses.en_web: It shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
verses.en_bbe: And it will be for Aaron and his sons; they are to take it for food in a holy place: it is the most holy of all the offerings made by fire to the Lord, a rule for ever.

verses.en: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
verses.pt: Naquele tempo apareceu no meio dos filhos de Israel o filho duma mulher israelita, o qual era filho dum egípcio; e o filho da israelita e um homem israelita pelejaram no arraial;
verses.en_web: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
verses.en_bbe: And a son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel and had a fight with a man of Israel by the tents;

verses.en: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the LORD, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.pt: e o filho da mulher israelita blasfemou o Nome, e praguejou; pelo que o trouxeram a Moisés. Ora, o nome de sua mãe era Selomite, filha de Dibri, da tribo de Dã.
verses.en_web: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of the Israelite woman said evil against the holy Name, with curses; and they took him to Moses. His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.en: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
verses.pt: Puseram-no, pois, em detenção, até que se lhes fizesse declaração pela boca do Senhor.
verses.en_web: They put him in custody, until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
verses.en_bbe: And they kept him shut up, till a decision might be given by the mouth of the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.pt: Tira para fora do arraial o que tem blasfemado; todos os que o ouviram porão as mãos sobre a cabeça dele, e toda a congregação o apedrejará.
verses.en_web: “Bring out of the camp him who cursed; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.en_bbe: Take the curser outside the tent-circle; and let all in whose hearing the words were said put their hands on his head, and let him be stoned by all the people.

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.pt: E dirás aos filhos de Israel: Todo homem que amaldiçoar o seu Deus, levará sobre si o seu pecado.
verses.en_web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
verses.en_bbe: And say to the children of Israel, As for any man cursing God, his sin will be on his head.

verses.en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD, shall be put to death.
verses.pt: E aquele que blasfemar o nome do Senhor, certamente será morto; toda a congregação certamente o apedrejará. Tanto o estrangeiro como o natural, que blasfemar o nome do Senhor, será morto.
verses.en_web: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And he who says evil against the name of the Lord will certainly be put to death; he will be stoned by all the people; the man who is not of your nation and one who is an Israelite by birth, whoever says evil against the holy Name is to be put to death.

verses.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.pt: Quem matar a alguém, certamente será morto;
verses.en_web: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone who takes another's life is certainly to be put to death.

verses.en: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.pt: e quem matar um animal, fará restituição por ele, vida por vida.
verses.en_web: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone wounding a beast and causing its death, will have to make payment for it: a life for a life.

verses.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.pt: Se alguém desfigurar o seu próximo, como ele fez, assim lhe será feito:
verses.en_web: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:
verses.en_bbe: And if a man does damage to his neighbour, as he has done, so let it be done to him;

verses.en: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
verses.pt: quebradura por quebradura, olho por olho, dente por dente; como ele tiver desfigurado algum homem, assim lhe será feito.
verses.en_web: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.
verses.en_bbe: Wound for wound, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever damage he has done, so let it be done to him.

verses.en: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.pt: Quem, pois, matar um animal, fará restituição por ele; mas quem matar um homem, será morto.
verses.en_web: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: He who puts a beast to death will have to make payment for it; he who puts a man to death will himself be put to death.

verses.en: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: uma mesma lei tereis, tanto para o estrangeiro como para o natural; pois eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”
verses.en_bbe: You are to have the same law for a man of another nation living among you as for an Israelite; for I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Então falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel. Depois eles levaram para fora do arraial aquele que tinha blasfemado e o apedrejaram. Fizeram, pois, os filhos de Israel como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
verses.en_web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, and they took the man who had been cursing outside the tent-circle and had him stoned. The children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
